description:
Asset purchases and disposals announced by Taiwan-listed companies (machinery and equipment, land and
    buildings, leases, shares of subsidiaries, capital injections), parsed from their filings, with the NT$ amount,
    place, counterparty and source link. Filter by company, asset_type (e.g. 'Machinery'), kind ('acquisition' or
    'disposal'), days back and minimum NT$ amount. Largest first.
name: get_investments
title: Investment announcements
